output_list.reason: The mint function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The totalSupply + _value <= TOKEN_LIMIT check is bypassed if _value is crafted to overflow.
The transfer function allows the owner to transfer tokens to any address, including a compromised exchange, causing token devaluation.
The transferFrom function allows the owner to transfer tokens from any address, including a compromised exchange, causing token devaluation.
The approve function allows the owner to approve an exchange, causing it to be able to transfer tokens from any address, including the owner's, causing token devaluation.
The typo in the constructor function allows it to be called on the blockchain, allowing attackers to set the exchange address, causing token devaluation.
